user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Never Thought I'd See The Day. A Century And A Quarter Of Life, And I'm Still Standing.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Jasper lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at the ceiling, a look of nostalgia washing over his face.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Remember When I First Heard The Theory. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A Parallel Universe Where They Survived.

**CUT TO:**

**JASPER'S MIND**

Jasper's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought. He begins to pace back and forth in his bed, his mind racing with the implications of the theory.

**JASPER** (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just Living In A Parallel Universe? The One Where I Never Died?

**CUT TO:**

**JASPER'S MIND - PARALLEL UNIVERSE**

Jasper finds himself standing in a world that looks identical to his own, but with subtle differences. People he knew and loved are now strangers, and the world is full of possibilities.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I See Myself As A Young Man, Full Of Life And Purpose. I See Myself Making Choices, Taking Risks, And Living A Life Free From Fear.

**CUT TO:**

**JASPER'S MIND - PARALLEL UNIVERSE - FLASHBACKS**

Jasper's mind is flooded with memories of his past, but they are distorted and twisted. He sees himself as a hero, a champion of justice and righteousness.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Am The Greatest Man The World Has Ever Known. I Am The One Who Will Save Humanity.

**CUT TO:**

**JASPER'S MIND - PARALLEL UNIVERSE - DESCENT INTO MADNESS**

Jasper's mind begins to unravel, consumed by the weight of his own ego and the crushing burden of his own mortality. He sees himself as a god, a deity above the laws of physics and reality.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Am The Only One Who Truly Understands The Universe. I Am The Only One Who Truly Knows The Truth.

**CUT TO:**

**JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Jasper's eyes snap back into focus, and he lies back in bed, his mind shattered by the weight of his own delusions. He stares at the ceiling, his eyes vacant and his soul lost.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Don't Know What's Real Anymore. I Don't Know What's True.

**FADE TO BLACK.**
